few_shot_examples.feedback: I tried reaching out because my order never arrived, but the chat agent was unhelpful and kept disconnecting. Total lack of help.
The app is very intuitive and easy to navigate, but I wish it had a dark mode and a price-tracking alert feature.
I was double-charged for my subscription and when I called customer service, they told me it would take 30 days to fix it. Unacceptable.
The headphones sound great, but the plastic casing feels very cheap and flimsy for the price I paid.
The new update made the checkout button almost impossible to find on smaller screens. It’s a mess.
Great selection of items, but the shipping carrier left my package in the rain and the box was soaked through.
Every time I try to update my credit card info, the system gives me an error. I just want to pay my bill!
The support team was friendly, but the product itself doesn't have the advanced filtering options I was promised.
The material of the shirt is top-notch, very soft and durable. It’s exactly what I was looking for.
I love the app's look, but I've been waiting two weeks for a response from your help desk about my missing promo code.
The courier left my package at the wrong house and I had to go find it myself.
I noticed a $15 'service fee' that wasn't mentioned anywhere during the checkout process.
I've been using this for a month and the stitching on the handle is already coming apart.
The support agent was very polite, but the app itself is so confusing that I couldn't even find where to start a return.
I love that you added the 'Buy Now, Pay Later' option, but it didn't apply my discount code correctly at checkout.
The laptop is incredibly fast and powerful, but it arrived in a box that looked like it had been stepped on.
I tried to use the new AR room-visualizer feature to see if the sofa fits, but the 'Help' documentation doesn't explain how to calibrate it, so I gave up.
The website is beautiful, but the search results are irrelevant and the actual items feel like cheap knock-offs once you hold them.
Your live chat keeps saying 'Connecting...' forever. I just want to know why I was charged twice for the same order.
The product is perfect, 10/10! But the box was slightly crushed. I don't really care because the item is fine, but just thought you should know.
